title: Bad Emperors
description: Explores the reigns and legacies of Rome’s worst emperors. Features readings in Greek and Roman historical sources alongside receptions of bad emperors in post-classical contexts. Topics include power dynamics between the emperor, the senatorial elite, and the army; the historical accuracy of gossip about emperors; the anxieties, resentments, and values of the elite that informed hostile biographies of emperors.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of GRS 352, GRS 326 (if taken in the same topic).
